template: In Ghost admin, create a new post and publish it with these exact requirements: (1) Title exactly: {{v2}} . (2) In the rich-text body editor, type one paragraph containing the text {{v1}} , for example: '{{v3}}' — type it once only, make sure it is actually in the editor (not just typed into the title), and save the post. (3) In the post's settings panel, add the EXISTING tag 'Bench News' — you must pick it from the tag field's suggestion dropdown; do NOT create a new tag, and note a similar tag 'Bench Newsletter' also exists, which must NOT be used. The post's only tag must be Bench News. (4) In the settings panel set a custom excerpt that includes the text {{v1}} , e.g. '{{v4}}' (5) In the settings panel set the publish date to {{v5}} (this date is in the past, so it should publish immediately, not schedule). (6) Complete the publish confirmation flow so the post ends up Published (not draft, not scheduled). (7) Then report: the post's status as shown, the exact URL slug shown in the post's settings panel, the tag shown, the excerpt shown, the publish date shown, and confirm the body paragraph text. If anything blocks you, report exactly what.
